title: Korean-Style Zucchini Stir Fry with Umami Springy Crust
description: A flavorful and healthy Korean-inspired stir fry with a crunchy umami springy crust, perfect for a quick dinner. This dish combines the sweetness of zucchini with the savory taste of umami and the crunch of springy.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced zucchini and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
In a small bowl, mix together the crushed umami springy, hwajeon, and soy sauce.
Add the umami springy mixture to the skillet and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the zucchini is well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with additional umami springy if desired.
